comparison.objective: Hand over and level-carry a rack of sample cups; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual handover and tilt control versus tool alignment, fine adjustment, counterholding, and tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Rack reaches the far pad with cups upright and registered; no damper-cycle criteria.
comparison.reason: Safe transport and handover do not test adjustment, locking, or dynamic-response inference.
